title: Separate exact shift structures for the two tensor comparisons
statement: For scheme derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], the quasi-coherent object property is triangulated. Let f:Z→Y and a:Lf*⊣Rf* be a specified adjunction [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For any E the functors K↦K⊗Rf*E and K↦Rf*(Lf*K⊗E), from D_QCoh(Y) to D(Y), admit separate coherent exact integer-shift structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. If Rf* restricts to D_QCoh, its specified right adjoint c and the quasi-coherent lift of K↦Lf*K⊗c(O_Y) likewise admit separate exact shift structures under the displayed quasi-coherence assumptions. No compatibility of a supplied monoidal tensorator, or of the comparison transformation, with these shifts is asserted.

proof.text: Identify supportedProperty(X,univ) with schemeDerivedQCohProperty X by extensionality and simp, then use its proved triangulated property.

Extract the exact shift structure of the existing derivedPullback from exists_derivedPullback. The specified adjunction a transports it to an exact right-adjoint shift structure on schemeDerivedDirectImage.

Use schemeCanonicalTensorShift and its tensorRight exactness property. Compose these exact functors and lift exactness through the full quasi-coherent inclusions. For c apply the restricted adjunction right-adjoint shift/exactness construction. Return the independently chosen structures in the displayed existential conclusions.

lean.statement:
theorem projection_exactStructures
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [(schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).IsTriangulated]
    (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory Z) :
    let F := (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙
      tensorRight ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)
    let G := (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙ derivedPullback f ⋙
      tensorRight E ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f
    ∃ (sF : F.CommShift ℤ) (sG : G.CommShift ℤ),
      letI := sF
      letI := sG
      F.IsTriangulated ∧ G.IsTriangulated
